none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained zero-finding for a monotone operator F:E→E: ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0. A zero xstar exists with ‖x0−xstar‖≤D. No scalar objective or potential structure is assumed.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Two exact oracles return F(x) and the full Fréchet derivative DF(x), respectively, at arbitrary queried points. Replies are independent of history and seeds. No second-derivative oracle is supplied. Each oracle has a separate fixed call budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/UnconstrainedLipschitzSecondDerivativeMonotone.lean: spec.numOracles, spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace and Convergence

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: F is C² and ‖D²F(x)−D²F(y)‖≤L‖x−y‖ globally; ‖DF(x0)‖≤H₀. Public information includes E, x0, L>0, D>0, H₀≥0 and ε>0. F and a witnessing zero are hidden; neither global Lipschitz continuity of F nor of DF is assumed.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The residual bound holds almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed law; deterministic output is not required.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The returned point x must satisfy the unsquared operator residual bound ‖F(x)‖≤ε.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Smooth monotone equation solving with exact operator and Jacobian information and a residual-norm target is an established formulation. This setup specifies higher smoothness, a known initial distance bound and an initial Jacobian bound.
